$comment: RemotionUI 已安装组件清单（供 Agent 查阅）。import 用 @/ 别名（@ -> src/）。用法以组件实际源码为准。

ChartDatum.shape: { label: string; value: number; color?: string; delta?: string }

ChartPoint.shape: { x: number; y: number; label?: string }

components.name: animated-bar-chart
components.description: 柱状图（含标题/副标题/坐标轴，整页场景）
components.props: data: ChartDatum[]; title?; subtitle?; maxValue?; valueFormatter?; highlightLabel?; showAxis?; maxBars?

components.name: line-chart-draw
components.description: 折线图（手绘式描线动画）
components.props: points: ChartPoint[]; width?; height?; color?; strokeWidth?; variant?('smooth'|'linear'); showAxis?; showXLabels?

components.name: donut-chart
components.description: 环形图（占比，可显示中心总数与图例）
components.props: segments: ChartDatum[]; size?; thickness?; colors?; showLegend?; showTotal?; totalLabel?

components.name: pie-slice-reveal
components.description: 饼图（扇区逐个揭示）
components.props: slices: ChartDatum[]; size?; colors?; showLabels?; explode?; gapInDegrees?

components.name: stacked-area-chart
components.description: 堆叠面积图（多序列构成随时间变化）
components.props: series: StackedSeries[]; labels?; width?; height?; durationInFrames?

components.name: funnel-chart
components.description: 漏斗图（阶段递减，如转化漏斗）
components.props: stages: FunnelStage[]; width?; height?; durationInFrames?

components.name: waterfall-chart
components.description: 瀑布图（增减分解）
components.props: steps: WaterfallStep[]; width?; height?; durationInFrames?

components.name: gauge-dial
components.description: 仪表盘（单值指针扫动）
components.props: value: number; min?; max?; size?; thickness?; sweepInDegrees?; color?; trackColor?

components.name: treemap-blocks
components.description: 矩形树图（层级份额）
components.props: blocks: ChartDatum[]; width?; height?; colors?; gap?; cornerRadius?; showShare?

components.name: sparkline-row
components.description: 迷你走势行（一行一指标，带涨跌标注）
components.props: values: number[]; label?; value?; delta?; color?; width?; durationInFrames?

components.name: candlestick-chart
components.description: K 线图（OHLC 行情，可加均线）
components.props: candles: Candle[]; width?; height?; upColor?; downColor?; showAxis?; movingAverage?; showLastPrice?

components.name: radar-chart
components.description: 雷达图（多维度对比）
components.props: axes: string[]; series: RadarSeries[]; durationInFrames?

components.name: bar-chart-race
components.description: 动态排名条形图（bar chart race）
components.props: series: RaceSeries[]; steps?; durationInFrames?

components.name: comparison-bars
components.description: 前后对比条形图（before/after 双条）
components.props: rows: ComparisonRowDatum[]; width?; rowHeight?; gap?; labelWidth?

components.name: counter
components.description: 数字滚动计数（千分位/小数/里程表式滚动）
components.props: to: number; from?; durationInFrames?; decimals?; grouping?; locale?; format?; prefix?; suffix?; roll?

components.name: progress-bar
components.description: 进度条（0-1 填充）
components.props: progress?; from?; durationInFrames?; delayInFrames?; spring?; color?; height?

components.name: stat-card
components.description: 统计卡片（大数字 + 环形仪表 + 涨跌 chip）
components.props: value?; max?; suffix?; prefix?; decimals?; label?; caption?; delta?

components.name: fade-in
components.description: 淡入（可带 exit 淡出）
components.props: children; durationInFrames?; delayInFrames?; spring?; exit?; from?; to?

components.name: slide-up
components.description: 上滑进入（可 mask 揭示）
components.props: children; durationInFrames?; delayInFrames?; distance?; mask?; spring?; exit?

components.name: scale-in
components.description: 缩放进入
components.props: children; durationInFrames?; from?; origin?; spring?; exit?

components.name: spring-in
components.description: 弹簧进入（smooth/snappy/bouncy 预设）
components.props: children; durationInFrames?; config?('smooth'|'snappy'|'bouncy'); from?; travel?; exit?

components.name: stagger-children
components.description: 子元素错峰进入（forward/reverse/center/edges）
components.props: children; order?; staggerInFrames?; durationInFrames?

components.name: typewriter
components.description: 打字机文字揭示（支持 [pause:x]、光标、循环）
components.props: text: string; charFrames?; durationInFrames?; humanize?; showCursor?; loop?; fontSize?; color?
